headline: iShares MSCI Brazil ETF Drops in U.S. Trading During Local Market Holiday
summary: The iShares MSCI Brazil ETF (EWZ) traded down in U.S. markets on Friday while Brazilian domestic asset exchanges were closed for Black Consciousness Day.
why: The EWZ ETF acts as the primary vehicle for international investors to gain price exposure to Brazilian equities when domestic exchange trading is closed.

impacts.name: iShares MSCI Brazil ETF
